item.title: A1301309
item.WebMemo:
Laken is a 10-year-old female dog in need of a rescue, foster, or adopter who can provide the medical care and support she urgently needs. She has a mammary mass that is concerning for possible cancer and requires surgical removal, along with further veterinary evaluation to determine the nature of the mass and whether additional treatment may be necessary.

Laken needs someone willing to help her receive the surgery and follow-up care that could make a difference in her future. As a young dog, she deserves the opportunity to receive the medical attention she needs and the chance to enjoy a healthy, happy life.

Please share Laken’s information to help us find a rescue, foster, or adopter who can step up for her and provide the care she needs.

If you are interested in helping Laken, please email dasadopt@dallas.gov with your contact information so we can call you back.

item.title: A1299450

item.title: A1301664
item.WebMemo:
Smokey is a male dog who presented bright, alert, and responsive (BAR) with probable severe glaucoma in the right eye (OD), a painful condition that can significantly impact his comfort and quality of life. Due to behavioral concerns, further diagnostics and treatment have been unable to be performed. Without appropriate evaluation and intervention, Smokey is at risk for ongoing pain, worsening ocular damage, and additional complications. Prompt veterinary assessment and treatment are recommended to address his condition and relieve potential discomfort. The specialized veterinary care and handling support needed to safely evaluate and manage Smokey’s condition exceed what we can consistently provide in the shelter environment.

Despite his medical concerns, Smokey requires a safe, compassionate placement where he can receive further veterinary evaluation, appropriate treatment for his suspected glaucoma, and ongoing care to support his comfort and quality of life. An experienced adopter, foster, or rescue able to work with his behavioral needs and facilitate veterinary care is needed.

Smokey is at risk for euthanasia due to medical concerns beyond our scope of care. If you are interested in adopting, fostering, or rescuing Smokey, please email dasadopt@dallas.gov. When emailing, please include a callback number.

item.title: A1301451
item.WebMemo:
Dolly is a joyful girl who is easy to handle, loves a good belly rub and engaging with everyone she has met.

Dolly is currently non-weight-bearing on her right forelimb (RF), with noticeable swelling of digit #3. These symptoms may indicate a painful injury or underlying medical condition requiring prompt veterinary evaluation and treatment. Without appropriate intervention, Dolly may experience continued pain, worsening swelling, and further complications. She requires further diagnostic assessment and appropriate medical care to determine the underlying cause and provide relief. This level of veterinary evaluation and treatment may exceed what we can consistently provide in the shelter environment.

Despite her condition, Dolly deserves a safe, compassionate placement where she can receive prompt veterinary evaluation, appropriate treatment, and supportive care to improve her comfort and mobility.

Dolly is at risk for euthanasia due to medical concerns beyond our scope of care. If you are interested in adopting, fostering, or rescuing this dog, please email dasadopt@dallas.gov. When emailing, please include a callback number.

item.title: A1288556
item.WebMemo:
Zeus is a male dog who presented bright, alert, and responsive (BAR) with a fractured right tibia and fibula, requiring urgent surgical intervention. His injuries are painful and will require surgical repair or amputation, depending on veterinary evaluation. Without prompt medical intervention, Zeus is at risk for ongoing pain, further complications, and impaired mobility. This level of specialized surgical care and postoperative recovery support exceeds what we can consistently provide in the shelter environment.

Despite his condition, Zeus remains resilient and is doing his best while receiving supportive care. Zeus needs a safe, compassionate placement where he can receive immediate surgical evaluation, appropriate treatment for his fractures, and the necessary recovery care to relieve his discomfort and improve his quality of life.

Zeus is at risk for euthanasia due to medical concerns beyond our scope of care. If you are interested in adopting, fostering, or rescuing Zeus, please email dasadopt@dallas.gov. When emailing, please include a callback number.

item.title: A1300352
item.WebMemo:
Raven is a 6-year-old female dog who is facing a difficult road ahead. She is suffering from significant arthritis in her spine, a painful condition that affects her comfort, mobility, and quality of life. Raven will require long-term, intensive care to manage her condition. Her needs will not be a quick fix. She will need ongoing veterinary care, medications, monitoring, pain management, and continued support to help keep her comfortable and maintain the best quality of life possible. Please consider sharing Raven's story. A simple share can reach someone who is able to help, and sometimes one share is all it takes to connect a dog in need with the person who can make a difference.

Raven is at risk for euthanasia due to her medical condition. Raven is available to an adopter, rescue or foster willing to manage and treat her medical condition. Please email dasadopt@dallas.gov if interested fostering or adopting. Please provide your full name and phone number.

item.title: A1301147
item.WebMemo:
HELP CRYSTAL GET THE SPECIALIZED CARE SHE NEEDS!

Meet Crystal, a sweet dog who needs our help and a chance at a brighter future.

Crystal has entropion in her right eye, a condition in which the eyelid rolls inward, potentially causing irritation, discomfort, and damage to the surface of the eye. She needs to be evaluated by a veterinary ophthalmologist to determine the best course of treatment and help protect her eye health.

Crystal deserves to be comfortable, receive the medical attention she needs, and have the opportunity to find a loving home. She needs someone willing to look beyond her medical condition and give her the chance she deserves.

Can you help Crystal?

We are looking for a rescue, foster, or adopter willing to step up for this deserving girl and help her get the specialized care she needs. If you cannot foster or adopt, please consider sharing her post. Your share could help Crystal reach the person who can change her life.

Crystal deserves a chance at a healthier, happier future. Please help us make that possible.

Please share for Crystal. Her second chance could start with you.

This animal is at risk for euthanasia. If you are interested in helping, please email dasadopt@dallas.gov with your contact information so we can call you back.

item.title: A1299220
item.WebMemo:
Lawlence is a four-year-old sweetheart with a gentle soul and a whole lot of love to give. He may be a little shy at first, but once he feels comfortable, his affectionate side shines through—and he’ll happily come back for more pets and cuddles.

In the yard, Lawlence enjoys taking his time to explore, but his favorite place seems to be right beside his person. He repeatedly returned to his volunteer for affection and closeness, showing just how much he values companionship. He even takes treats with the gentlest touch and remained calm and sweet throughout their time together.

Lawlence seemed comfortable around the other dogs while out in the yard, though passing other dogs’ kennels appeared to make him a little nervous. With patience, reassurance, and a loving home, we think this tender-hearted boy will blossom beautifully.

If you’re looking for a gentle companion who will appreciate every bit of love you give him, Lawlence may be your perfect match.

Lawlence is at risk for euthanasia due to the current shelter capacity. Currently the shelter is above capacity to adequately house and care for animals. Lawlence would benefit from individualized attention with a foster, adopter or rescue partner. Please email dasadopt@dallas.gov if interested fostering or adopting. Please provide your full name and phone number.

item.title: A1297384
item.WebMemo:
Giuseppe is a sweet boy! He loves cuddles, treats, learning new things, and running with his friends. Giusseppe is still learning how to be a house dog and would do best in a patient environment where he can get puzzles, exercise, and toys that are put up and saved for individual playtime. He's learning how to sit, wait/stay, and stay on all fours when he's excited to see his favorite people. He responds well to whistles, treats, and praise! He loves his kennel where he feels safe and would do well in a home where he can continue his training, annual heartworm injections, and learn new things with you!
